## Appearance

Anne is a slender girl with a pointed, freckled face and pale skin. She has solemn, luminous gray eyes that can shine like stars or swell with big tears, along with a pretty nose featuring seven distinct freckles. Noted for her skinny, thin build, she has long red hair—also described as auburn or [Titian](../character/titian.md)—which she wears in braids or leaves streaming. At one point, her hair was accidentally dyed green.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P0](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER VII. Anne Says Her Prayers P12](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0012), [v1 CHAPTER VIII. ## Personality

Driven by her aspirations, she aims to attend [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) and win the Thorburn Scholarship in English, hoping to gain knowledge on how to live life best, add beauty to the world, and eventually write a story good enough for publication. Her long-term goal after finishing college is to stick to teaching, having previously wanted to pass her examinations high for Matthew's sake and work hard to win the Avery scholarship. Characterized as talkative, passionate, and romantic, she possesses an intense imagination, though this high degree of daydreaming combined with a heedless and impulsive nature often leaves her forgetful and prone to making mistakes. She harbors a notable vanity regarding her long, thick, curly red hair, and she deeply fears traversing the [Haunted Wood](../codex/places.md#haunted-wood) after dark due to terrors of white things grabbing her. Possessing a natural knack and fondness for children, she is exceptionally skilled at nursing and treating young children with croup, while also seeking to win over a young student like [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md). Additionally, she demonstrates talent in rowing a dory, writing compositions, decorating artistically, public recitation, singing with a good voice, and imaginative storytelling.

## History

Born in [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke), [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia), Anne Shirley lost her parents in early infancy and spent her early childhood moving between guardians and an asylum [F2, F3, F4, F5, F9, F13]. At eleven years old, she was brought to Prince [Edward Island](../codex/places.md#edward-island) by Mrs. [Spencer](../character/spencer.md), where [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) and [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) ultimately decided to adopt her at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) [F12, S1, S3, S5]. She quickly swore an oath of lifelong friendship with [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) and developed a fierce, long-standing rivalry with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) after he pulled her hair at school [S9, S13]. Following years of local schooling and attending Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy), she gave up her college scholarship to remain at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) after [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) died, working as the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) teacher to support [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) [S40, S42, S43]. During her tenure as a teacher, she helped [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) raise the orphaned twins [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md) Keith while actively participating in the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) [S49, S52]. Later, Anne left for [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) to pursue her degree, moving into a charming house called Patty's Place with her friends [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md), and [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md) [S81, S85, S89, S95]. Throughout her college years, she received and rejected multiple marriage proposals, including an awkward proxy proposal from [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) on behalf of her brother [Billy](../character/billy-andrews.md), as well as an earnest declaration from [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) [S87, S100]. Although she spent months courted by [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md), she ultimately turned down his proposal after realizing she did not love him [S103, S114]. Upon returning to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) after graduation, she discovered that [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) had not engaged [Christine Stuart](../character/christine-stuart.md) as rumored [S113, S116]. Walking together to Hester Gray's garden, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) proposed once more, and Anne joyfully accepted, ending their long misunderstandings and becoming engaged [S116].

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P1](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER III. ## Quotes

> "Pretty well. I’m better at looking after children, though. I’ve had so much experience at that. It’s such a pity you haven’t any here for me to look after."
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables P24](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0024)

> “I think he’s lovely,” said Anne reproachfully. “He is so very sympathetic. He didn’t mind how much I talked—he seemed to like it. I felt that he was a kindred spirit as soon as ever I saw him.”
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables P26](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0026)

> "Oh, I don’t mean that sort of a name. I mean just a name you gave it yourself. Didn’t you give it a name? May I give it one then? May I call it—let me see—Bonny would do—may I call it Bonny while I’m here? Oh, do let me!"
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables P33](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0033)

> "Pretty well. I imagine a good deal, and that helps to pass the time. Of course, it’s rather lonesome. But then, I may as well get used to that."
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P11](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0011)

> "I don’t get cross about other things; but I’m so tired of being twitted about my hair and it just makes me boil right over. Do you suppose my hair will really be a handsome auburn when I grow up?"
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P43](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0043)

## Relationships

### [Allan](../character/allan.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/allan--anne-shirley.md)

Mrs. Allan and Anne become good friends following Mrs. Allan's arrival as the new minister's wife. Their early interaction involves Mrs. Allan kindly comforting Anne when a layer cake for tea is accidentally ruined with liniment. Over time, Mrs. Allan offers Anne encouraging guidance on ideals, teaching, and grief, such as comforting her following Matthew's funeral and walking home with her after graveyard visits.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P29](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0029), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P31](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0031), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P35](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0035), +20 more_

### [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--charlie-sloane.md)

Anne and Charlie initially share a mutual distaste and resentment during their early school days. Their dynamic shifts into camaraderie as they grow older and embark on their studies at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) together. They travel alongside each other to [Kingsport](../codex/places.md#kingsport) and join larger group outings with mutual friends.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P23](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0023), [v3 ch.Farewell P0](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0000), [v3 ch.Farewell P2](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0002), +6 more_

### [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--diana-barry.md)

[Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) is Anne's closest companion and self-described bosom friend, a bond formed quickly during their first meeting in the garden at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope). Through childhood misadventures, personal milestones, and shared imaginative pursuits, their loyal friendship remains central to Anne's life as both grow into adulthood.

### [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--gilbert-blythe.md)

Anne's dynamic with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) begins with intense resentment after he pulls her braid and calls her 'Carrots,' leading to a fierce academic rivalry throughout their school years. Though [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) holds a deep romantic infatuation for Anne and eventually rescues her from a boating mishap, Anne holds onto her grudge for a long time before they reconcile into friends. While [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) eventually confesses his love and proposes, Anne rejects his romantic advances to protect their friendship, though she continues to feel conflicted about his place in her life.

Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) and Anne begin their relationship with an argument after Anne's cow breaks into his oats, followed by Anne accidentally selling his Jersey cow. However, after Anne visits to confess her mistake, Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) takes it in good humor, and the two become good friends and friendly neighbors.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P4](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0004), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P15](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0015), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P28](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0028), +17 more_

Miss Lavendar [Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) is a dear friend and kindred spirit to Anne, whom Anne stumbles upon while lost in the woods near [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). ### [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--roy-gardner.md)

[Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md) courts Anne for two years while she attends [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). Although those around them expect them to marry, Anne realizes she does not truly love him when he formally proposes, leading her to refuse his proposal.

### [Rusty](../character/rusty.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--rusty.md)

[Rusty](../character/rusty.md) is a stray cat adopted by Anne and brought to live at Patty's Place. Anne acts as a protective companion to him, frequently taking his side during his persistent territorial fights with Aunt Jamesina's cat, [Joseph](../character/joseph.md).
